summary: Reviewed 9 units. 2 error, 18 minor. Errors: unit 4 Hindi invents "फल" and misstates apratīni; unit 9 refrain "mightily" against glossary "greatly". Minor: prayas rendered two ways (delicacy / refreshments), vayaḥ gender, गढ़ vs नगर, iṣ as अन्न, navīyaḥ Hindi/English mismatch, unit 5 Hindi adds सोम, guhat and nanamaḥ gram over-committed, आनन्द for mada. Units 1, 5, 7 low confidence is honest. No regrouping suggested.
